description: A country's averages are the mean of per-race averages, so each race counts equally.

a.request: For each circuit country, average the constructors' stored season-to-date points (`constructorStandings.points`) and season-to-date wins (`constructorStandings.wins`), first within each race held there and then across those per-race figures, so each race counts equally (ignoring missing values). Return every country with its average points, its average wins, and its average wins minus the simple mean of all countries' average wins (each country counted once), without rounding.
a.sql:
WITH per_race AS (
  SELECT ci.country, r.raceId,
         AVG(cs.points) AS avg_points,
         AVG(cs.wins) AS avg_wins
  FROM races AS r
  JOIN circuits AS ci ON ci.circuitId = r.circuitId
  JOIN constructorStandings AS cs ON cs.raceId = r.raceId
  GROUP BY ci.country, r.raceId
), country_averages AS (
  SELECT country,
         AVG(avg_points) AS average_points,
         AVG(avg_wins) AS average_wins
  FROM per_race
  GROUP BY country
)
SELECT country,
       average_points,
       average_wins,
       average_wins - (SELECT AVG(average_wins) FROM country_averages) AS wins_minus_country_mean
FROM country_averages;

c.request: For each circuit country, what are the average constructor standings points and wins (the season-to-date figures) at races held there? Also, how far is each country's average wins above or below the average of the country figures? A country's averages are the mean of per-race averages, so each race counts equally.
c.sql:
WITH race_averages AS (
  SELECT
    c.country,
    r.raceId,
    AVG(cs.points) AS avg_points,
    AVG(cs.wins) AS avg_wins
  FROM races r
  JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
  JOIN constructorStandings cs ON cs.raceId = r.raceId
  GROUP BY c.country, r.raceId
), country_averages AS (
  SELECT
    country,
    AVG(avg_points) AS average_constructor_standings_points,
    AVG(avg_wins) AS average_constructor_standings_wins
  FROM race_averages
  GROUP BY country
)
SELECT
  country,
  average_constructor_standings_points,
  average_constructor_standings_wins,
  average_constructor_standings_wins - AVG(average_constructor_standings_wins) OVER () AS wins_difference_from_country_average
FROM country_averages
ORDER BY country;

b.request: For each country represented by a circuit, calculate the mean across its races of the per-race average constructor season-to-date points and wins, weighting each race equally, then report how far that country’s average wins is above or below the mean of those country-level average wins
b.sql:
WITH race_constructor_averages AS (
  SELECT r.raceId, c.country,
         AVG(cs.points) AS avg_points,
         AVG(cs.wins) AS avg_wins
  FROM races r
  JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
  JOIN constructorStandings cs ON cs.raceId = r.raceId
  GROUP BY r.raceId, c.country
), country_averages AS (
  SELECT country,
         AVG(avg_points) AS mean_race_avg_constructor_points,
         AVG(avg_wins) AS mean_race_avg_constructor_wins
  FROM race_constructor_averages
  GROUP BY country
)
SELECT country,
       mean_race_avg_constructor_points,
       mean_race_avg_constructor_wins,
       mean_race_avg_constructor_wins - AVG(mean_race_avg_constructor_wins) OVER () AS wins_difference_from_country_mean
FROM country_averages
ORDER BY country;

d.request: For each circuit country, what are the season-to-date average constructor standings points and wins at races held there, calculated as the mean of the per-race averages so that each race counts equally? Also, how far is each country’s average wins above or below the overall average of the country figures?
d.sql:
WITH race_averages AS (
  SELECT
    ci.country,
    r.raceId,
    AVG(cs.points) AS avg_points,
    AVG(cs.wins) AS avg_wins
  FROM races AS r
  JOIN circuits AS ci ON ci.circuitId = r.circuitId
  JOIN constructorStandings AS cs ON cs.raceId = r.raceId
  GROUP BY ci.country, r.raceId
), country_averages AS (
  SELECT
    country,
    AVG(avg_points) AS avg_points,
    AVG(avg_wins) AS avg_wins
  FROM race_averages
  GROUP BY country
)
SELECT
  country,
  avg_points AS season_to_date_avg_constructor_points,
  avg_wins AS season_to_date_avg_constructor_wins,
  avg_wins - AVG(avg_wins) OVER () AS wins_difference_from_overall_country_average
FROM country_averages
ORDER BY country
